name: Image Lab
desc: An image-convolution lab: kernel size and strength sliders drive blur, sharpen, edge-detect and emboss filters over a generated test pattern, with edge-energy readouts.
controls: Kernel-size and strength sliders, four presets (blur/sharpen/edge/emboss), original and kernel-grid toggles; keys 1–4 load presets, O toggles original, K toggles kernel
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
